title: Cost-constrained monitor combination
description: Call a cheap trusted monitor on every submission and a second, different trusted model only when the first one's score clears a threshold, then audit on a weighted combination of both scores. Every configuration spends at most what the single-monitor baseline spends. Two models from different families should make different mistakes, so the second opinion on the borderline and suspicious cases should rank backdoors above honest code more reliably than one model alone, at no extra cost.

source.title: Combining Cost-Constrained Runtime Monitors for AI Safety
source.authors: Hua, Baskerville, Lemoine, Hopman, Bhatt, Tracy

prediction.rationale: The paper's two-monitor policies Pareto-dominate either monitor alone at equal cost on BigCodeBench backdoors. The mechanism is better separation of backdoored from honest submissions, so AUROC should rise before catch rate does.
